title: 計測工学
subtitle: Instrumentaion engineering
educationalGoal: With the development of automated machines, mechanical systems' measurement and control technologies are essential for engineers who use and design machines. In this course, students will: Acquire basic knowledge of measurement technology. Enable to discuss some measurement methods.
advice: In this course, students will learn the fundamentals of measurement, mainly the following Standards of measurement Configuration and characteristics of measurement systems Uncertainty of measurement Signal conversion Data processing The class will be conducted in a question-and-answer format, with preparation required.
books: Wei Gao et al., Measurement and Instrumentation (2018 Asakura Pub.)

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the metrics that describe the characteristics of a measurement system.
Be able to explain the traceability of measurement.
Be able to express the measurement results using SIubit with the uncertainty.
Be able to explain the processing of time-series data.
Be able to explain the method and principle of measurement of physical quantities.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1. Be able to propose the measurement method with high precision. 2. Be able to explain the necessity of traceability of measurement. 3. Be able to evaluate the uncertainty 4. Be able to perform appropriate time-series signal data processing for appropriate measurement targets. 5. Be able to explain the method and principle of measurement of physical quantities.
achievementLevels.standard: 1. Be able to explain the characteristics of the measurement system. 2. Be able to explain the traceability of measurement. 3. Be able to explain the uncertainty 4. Be able to show an example of a time-series signal. 5. Be able to explain the measurement method of some physical quantities.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
